definitions.explanation: A formally imposed restriction forbidding some activity. Standalone use is largely confined to set expressions; the kanji is more commonly seen in compounds such as {禁止|きんし} (prohibition) or {禁酒|きんしゅ} (abstaining from alcohol).

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}の{禁|きん}がついに{解|と}かれた。
examples.english: The long-standing ban was finally lifted.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}は{特定|とくてい}の{薬物|やくぶつ}に{禁|きん}を{課|か}している。
examples.english: The government has imposed a ban on certain drugs.

notes:
Mostly used in set expressions; everyday writing usually prefers the compound {禁止|きんし}.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {禁|きん}を{解|と}く: to lift a ban
- {禁|きん}を{犯|おか}す: to violate a ban
- {禁|きん}を{破|やぶ}る: to break a ban
- {禁|きん}を{課|か}す: to impose a ban

COMPOUNDS:
- {禁止|きんし}: prohibition (most common everyday term)
- {禁酒|きんしゅ}: abstaining from alcohol
- {禁煙|きんえん}: no smoking; quitting smoking
